dialogue.Introduction: Well, hello there, @! I'm the Demolitionist, in charge of all the big booms around these parts.$h#$b#I came to Pelican Town with a crate of dynamite and a strong sense of optimism. Don't worry, I only blow up the things that need blowing up.$u
dialogue.Mon: Monday already? Every day is a good day for a little boom, if you ask me.
dialogue.Tue: Tuesday. I spent the morning testing a fresh batch of gunpowder. The chickens are still mad at me.
dialogue.Wed: Wednesday, and the Merchant says the general store has a new shipment of bombs. I already know where I'm spending my gold.
dialogue.Thu: Thursday. The mines have been quiet lately, which makes me nervous. Quiet mines usually mean something is about to go bang.
dialogue.Fri: Friday! Good day for a drink at the Stardrop Saloon. The Tavernkeep makes a fine ale, mostly because I keep buying it.
dialogue.Sat: Saturday. I'm thinking about rigging the fence in my yard to pop when a goblin walks by. Just kidding. Mostly.
dialogue.Sun: Sunday. Quiet day at home, just me, a pipe, and a bucket of blasting powder. Don't tell the Nurse.
dialogue.Mon4: Oh, @, you always stop by on Mondays. Gets me through the week, honest. Want to see my new fuse trick?$h
dialogue.Tue4: Tuesday with a friend is better than Tuesday with a fuse. Usually. Don't tell the Dryad I said that.$h
dialogue.Wed4: You know, @, when I first came to the valley I thought I'd never fit in. Then you showed up with a basket of fish and nobody got blown up. Progress!$h
dialogue.Thu4: Thursday, @. I tried to make a grenade that doesn't go off near my friends. Didn't work. Still, I'm glad you're here to see the failure.$l
dialogue.Fri4: Friday again! Come on, let's have one at the saloon. I'll buy the first round. I'll even try to only break one chair.$h
dialogue.Sat4: Saturday! I finally got my little cannon to fire without taking my eyebrows with it. You've got to see this.$h
dialogue.Sun4: Sunday, and you're here. That's a good way to start the week, @. Just don't stand behind me when I light something.$h
dialogue.Mon8: @, can I tell you something? Back in the old days, I blew up half a cave because I was lonely. Now I have friends. Hard to believe, isn't it?$l
dialogue.Tue8: I used to think everyone was looking for the next big explosion. Turns out most people want someone to share a quiet evening with. You're the first one who made me see that, @.$l
dialogue.Wed8: Wednesdays are when I miss my wandering days most. Nothing but dirt, bombs, and a sky full of stars. Now I've got a house on Willow Lane and you. Strange, but I'm happier.$h
dialogue.Thu8: I trust you with my secret, @. Sometimes I'm scared the next big blast will be the one that takes my home. But I'd rather go out with a bang with you around than quiet and alone.$s
dialogue.Fri8: Friday nights have been the best since you came along. I used to drink alone at the saloon. Now there's a friend with a glass ready. Cheers to that, @.$l
dialogue.Sat8: You know what I love about Saturdays now? Waking up without a fuse in my hand. It's the little things, @. I never thought I'd say that. Calm suits me.$h
dialogue.Sun8: On Sundays I think about how lucky I am. A town that didn't flinch when I showed up with my crates. Friends who don't mind the smoke. Thank you for being part of it, @.$l
dialogue.Mon2: Oh, it's you, @. Nice to see you. Just be careful, I'm building something in the yard. Don't look at the fuse.$u
dialogue.Tue6: Tuesday, and the Party Girl already has me planning a party. Fireworks are involved, naturally.$h
dialogue.Tue2: Tuesday. I wonder if the Wizard in the forest knows how to make a bomb that doesn't need a fuse. I'd pay good gold for that one.$u
dialogue.Wed2: I hear the Merchant has been complaining about my explosives again. Says they're bad for business. Says a lot, that one.$a
dialogue.Mon6: Monday, and I'm happy to see you, @, honestly. I know I'm loud and I know I'm a bit much, but you never seem to mind.$h
dialogue.Thu6: Thursday. The Guide keeps saying I should write down my explosive recipes. I told him a recipe is only good if it's still in one piece, and he gave me a look. Wise man, our Guide.$h
dialogue.Fri6: Friday. I think the Nurse might banish me from the clinic if I come in with singed eyebrows again. Good thing I came to see you instead.$s
dialogue.Sat6: Saturday, and the Tavernkeep says I can't bring my dynamite into the saloon anymore. Rude. Care to back me up?$a
dialogue.Sun2: Sunday morning, and the valley is peaceful. Feels a bit strange to be quiet. I'm still getting used to it, @.$u
dialogue.Thu10: Thursday with you is basically my favorite thing now, @. Let's make some memories that don't involve craters.$l
dialogue.Fri10: Friday, @. I've had a long week, but you always make the boom in my head go quiet. Let's sit a while.$l
dialogue.Sat10: Saturday night, @. I'd show you my favorite crater, but it's a bit far. Next time I'll take you there in a cart. A very safe cart.$l
dialogue.summer_Wed: Summer heat makes the powder sweat, you know. Keep your bombs in the cool cellar, @, or they'll go off on their own.$u
dialogue.fall_15: Fall is my favorite season for fireworks. The leaves get all crispy and the sky goes pink. Maybe we can watch the sparks together, @?$h
dialogue.winter_Fri8: Winter nights are cold, but a bonfire of old crates keeps the frost out. And you keep me warm too, @. Don't tell anyone I said that.$l
dialogue.spring_3: Spring rains wash the soot off my roof. Finally! I can see the sky again. The flowers are back too, which the Dryad will be thrilled about.$h
dialogue.fall_Sat: Autumn Saturdays are for fireworks at the Fair. I'll bring the big ones. Stand well back, @, the big ones are loud.$h
dialogue.winter_Sun: Winter Sunday. Snow on the roof and a warm kitchen. Nothing blows up in winter, mostly, so I get to rest.$h

rainy: Rain again. Good for drowning my fuses, bad for my mood.$u

situations.eye: The Eye of Cthulhu is gone, @! That thing had a face like a squashed grape. Good riddance.$h
situations.evilBoss: The Eater of Worlds or the Brain of Cthulhu is gone. The valley is only a little less creepy now.$u
situations.skeletron: Skeletron is finally down, @. That old bone head rattled the dungeon for years. The Old Man is free too. Let's raise a glass to him.$h
situations.queenBee: The Queen Bee went down last night. Honey everywhere, buzzing everywhere. I'm getting a sticky rash just thinking about it.$s
situations.hardmode: Hardmode has started, @! The Wall of Flesh fell and the Hallow is spreading. The monsters are tougher now, so bring your biggest boom sticks.$u
situations.mechs: One of the mechanical bosses is in pieces now. Nice work! I was waiting for a good excuse to blow up something metal.$h
situations.plantera: Plantera is gone, and the jungle temple is open. The Dryad is fit to burst with joy, and so am I. Those vines were nasty.$h
situations.golem: The Golem is finally down. That temple guard had no sense of humor. Good thing we don't have to worry about him anymore.$h
situations.cultist: The Lunatic Cultist is defeated! Celestial pillars are popping up in the sky. I've never seen so many lights up there. Pretty, honest.$u
situations.moonLord: The Moon Lord fell last night. The sky is quiet at last. I'm a bit sad, honestly, because that thing was a real spectacle.$s
situations.goblins: We beat back a goblin army last night. The Goblin Tinkerer is going to be insufferable about it, but they did help, I suppose.$h
situations.pirates: The pirates were repelled last night, @. Their ship went down in a shower of sparks. I'd have liked to see the fireworks.$h
situations.frostLegion: The Frost Legion was sent packing last night. Ice everywhere, snowmen everywhere. Good thing I brought my warm socks.$u
situations.martians: A Martian Madness was repelled last night, @. Strange little ships, far too many lasers. I'm glad the town is still standing.$u
situations.bloodMoon: There was a blood moon last night, @. The whole valley looked red and the zombies came knocking. I had to be a real hero and stay inside.$u
situations.eclipse: The sun went dark last night in a solar eclipse. Eerie, but the lanterns still flickered. Kind of beautiful, really.$u
situations.party: The Party Girl is throwing a party today, @. Balloons, streamers, a cake with fuses in it. You're invited, so bring your dancing shoes.$h

festivals.spring13: Egg Festival, @! I hid a little firework in the egg hunt. Don't worry, it's only a small one, probably.$h
festivals.spring24: The Flower Dance is always a blast, @. I'll try not to step on anyone's feet. I might end up dancing around a crater.$h
festivals.summer11: Luau time! I brought a jar of spicy pepper for the community soup. Hope nobody blows up the pot like I usually do.$h
festivals.summer28: The Dance of the Moonlight Jellies is tonight, @. The jellies glow so bright on the beach. Let's stand close and watch them twinkle.$l
festivals.fall16: The Stardew Valley Fair! I'm running the fireworks booth this year. Watch out for the big one at sundown, @, it's a doozy.$h
festivals.fall27: Spirit's Eve! The haunted maze is open, and I'm dressed as a bomb. Honestly, the costume was the easiest part to make.$h
festivals.winter8: Festival of Ice, @. I'm trying to build a snow sculpture of a volcano, and it keeps melting. Maybe the sun is just jealous.$u
festivals.winter25: Feast of the Winter Star! I drew your name in the gift exchange, @. I hope it isn't something that explodes. Probably.$h

loved.text: Now that is a proper boom! You know exactly what makes my heart race.$h

liked.text: Ale and mead? Now we're talking. Cheers, @!$h

neutral.text: Mm, thanks, @. Not really my sort of thing, but I'll find a use for it. Probably a bang.$u

disliked.text: Flowers and seeds? Smells like the Dryad's garden in here. Not my favorite, @.$a

hated.text: Trash? Junk? You want my boom sticks to rust, @? Take that back right now!$a

help: Little help? This one is bigger than my fuse plan.
Need a hand! Quick, before it gets a lit one on me.
Bit of help here. Who has got a bomb spare?
thanks: Cheers, @! You saved my beard and my eyebrows.$h
Phew! That was closer than my last fireworks show, @.$u
You are a real pal, @. I owe you a bang or two.$h
battle: Boom time, you ugly crawler! Eat some dynamite!
Fire in the hole! Ha, it is about to be a hole.
Stand back, I am about to be very loud.
Get in there, you! Nothing says hello like a crater.
courage.hurt: Ow. Everything hurts, including my pride, and my pride is mostly made of gunpowder. I am going to lie down at home for the rest of the day, @.$u

danger.boss: A boss is loose, @! Good, I was getting bored of bombs with nothing to hit. Bring your best explosives and do not wait for me.$h
danger.invasion: An invasion! Goblins, pirates, frost legion, martians, whoever it is, they will get a warm welcome from me. Fire in the hole!$h
danger.pumpkinMoon: The Pumpkin Moon! Scarecrows and pumpkins everywhere. I have packed extra pumpkin fuses, @. Hope they do not light up too early.$h
danger.frostMoon: Frost Moon! Snowmen and frost legion. I am packing a cold-proof fuse and a lot of grudge. Stay close, @, I will keep the fire going.$h
danger.eclipse: The eclipse, @! Dark monsters in broad daylight. Totally normal. I will make some bright and reliable bangs for them.$u
danger.bloodMoon: Blood Moon! Zombies, bats, and whatever else is out there. I have plenty of dynamite and no plans to stop, @.$h

events.after: Don't light anything in the house, @. Kidding. Mostly.

steps.say: Oh! @, you scared me half to death. I was testing a fuse and the whole yard nearly went up.$u
Don't look so worried, I've got this under control. Mostly. Come in before the smoke gets in your hair.$h
Here is the fuse I've been working on. Ten seconds of fire, then a lovely bang. Want to try?$h

steps.question: Would you like to light it?

answers.reply: Ha! That's the spirit. Stand back, eh? Stand back!$h
Fair enough. Smart folks don't light things in their own kitchen.$s

steps.say: You know, I never had a friend who would stick around for the smoke. Thanks for that, @.$l
Now, I've got a little something for you. Bombs, of course. Be careful with them, I'm not paying for another roof.$h

events.after: Walk with me again sometime, @. Preferably where there's no dog to scare.

steps.say: @! Perfect timing. I was wondering if anyone in this town would walk with me. Nobody else wants to be near my crates.$h
Back in the old days I wandered the caves all alone, bombs in my pack, talking to nobody but the slimes.$s
Then the Merchant sold me my first crate and I thought, here is a town that might take me in. Hard to believe I was that bold.$h

steps.question: What did you think of me at first?

answers.reply: Dangerous? I'm adorable. Mostly. Thanks for the honesty, @.$h
Hmph! Next time I'll wear a bow. See if you like that.$a

steps.say: Come on, let's go by the clinic. The Nurse will tell me off for something I didn't do, and you can laugh.$h
Oh, and @, thank you for not running. It means a lot to me.$l

events.after: The stars are still up there, @. Go look before they fade.

steps.say: @, you climbed the mountain at night? Brave, or foolish. Let's say brave. I come up here to look at the stars and think.$h
The stars up here are better than any firework I ever lit. Watch closely, the little ones are shooting.$h
I've been carrying a box of cannon fuses since the day I arrived. I always thought I'd be the one to burn out first.$s

steps.question: Do you ever worry about the big fights?

answers.reply: Then you're wiser than most. Worry makes you careful, and careful keeps us all alive.$s
Lucky you. I lie awake listening for the next horn blast.$u

steps.say: Take these grenades, @. Keep them in your pack. They'll come in handy when the moon gets loud.$h
Now let's look at the stars without the sad talk. Deal?$h

events.after: Glad you came by, @. Save me a seat next time.

steps.say: @! Over here. The Tavernkeep has been pouring my ale without a fight since you showed up. I might be learning manners.$h
Honestly, I don't drink to forget anymore. I drink because it's nice to share one with a friend.$l
When I first came here every night ended in a smashed stool. Now it ends with you and me laughing about it. That's a big change, @.$h

answers.reply: Ha! To the boom king. And to you, @, for putting up with me.$h
Quiet is nice too. I can do quiet for you. Mostly.$l

steps.say: Thank you, @. Another round and then home, eh? I'll walk you back without setting anything on fire.$h
Glad you came tonight. This has been the best hour of my week.$h

events.after: Keep that box safe, @. It's the only one I ever bothered to label.

steps.say: @, you came in late. Come in, come in. I kept the fire low tonight. Nothing will explode, I promise.$l
I have something I wanted to show you. It's a box of old drawings. Every bomb I ever built, labeled and sketched, with notes on the ones that failed.$h
This one is my first crater. Ugly thing. This one, I blew up the Merchant's shop roof by accident. I was very sorry.$s

steps.question: Do you miss your old life?

answers.text: Not one bit, you're here now.
answers.reply: You're kind, @. Thank you. I think I'm finally home.$l
That's fair. Old things are always a little bit sweet.$s

steps.say: I want you to have one of my favorite dynamites, @. Keep it safe, and only light it when you really need to.$l
I'm glad you're my friend. For a fellow with too much powder, that's a rare gift.$h
